stb's image reader and writer, vendored from [nothings/stb](https://github.com/nothings/stb) commit `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20` (MIT or public domain, see `LICENSE`). stb has no releases, so a commit is pinned. Only `stb_image.h` and `stb_image_write.h` are kept.

To update, replace them and `LICENSE` from the new commit's archive, and change the commit here.
